June 30 decisions: Rasual Butler: team option exercised; Sean Lampley: team option exercised; Ken Johnson: team option declined; Eddie House: qualifying offer tendered; Malik Allen: qualifying offer tendered; Mike James: qualifying offer tendered; Anthony Carter: player option exercised (his decision, drawn). Free agency opens; Miami's free agents on the register: Alonzo Mourning, Malik Allen, Travis Best, Eddie House, Mike James, Ken Johnson, Sean Marks, Vladimir Stepania.

Front-office plan (prior cap, projected): room $-5,328,528 after renouncing when needed Alonzo Mourning; targets Jason Kidd (sign_and_trade, ask $10,626,721), Keon Clark (mid_level, ask $3,775,765). Record: `Plans/plan_2003-07-01.json`.
Wade's request to pursue Andre Miller: not pursued (ask $5,780,236 does not fit the room ($-5,328,528 left) or the exceptions; score 21.456).
Wade's request to pursue Lamar Odom: not pursued (ask $6,142,338 does not fit the room ($-5,328,528 left) or the exceptions; score 13.412).
